review.use_summary: Back-translated the MAFFT protein alignment with corresponding nucleotide sequences into a codon alignment before EasyCodeML/CodeML positive-selection tests.
review.implementation_scope_note: The reported v14 has a named native matching profile. The native workflow can back-translate supplied complete aligned proteins and corresponding DNA/RNA with explicit identity, placement, code, normalization, selection, filtering and verification choices. The paper does not report the complete PAL2NAL command, genetic code or filtering/admission thresholds; do not infer them from the organisms. MAFFT alignment, IQ-TREE phylogeny and EasyCodeML/CodeML selection inference remain separate. Native codon conversion does not reproduce those steps or the full paper.

review.use_summary: Used PAL2NAL with ClustalW2 to prepare homolog-pair alignments for PAML CODEML Ka/Ks analysis within syntenic gene families.
review.implementation_scope_note: The reported v14.1 has a distinct named native matching profile backed by the Bioconda-pinned source and fresh controls; it is not silently replaced by v14. The authors exact build and PAL2NAL genetic-code, pairing, normalization, selection, filtering and verification settings are unreported. Supply explicit complete peptide/nucleotide inputs and choices. DIAMOND comparison, mSynOrths clustering, ClustalW2 alignment, PAML CODEML estimation and geographic haplotype tests remain separate; native back-translation does not calculate Ka/Ks or reconstruct the paper.
